info.title: eventstore-admin
info.description: Compatibility binary, not retired; see "Legacy compatibility surfaces" in the repository README for its removal gate. Hexalith EventStore administration CLI — manage streams, projections, snapshots, backups, tenants, and health checks from the terminal. Supports JSON/CSV/table output, exit codes for CI/CD, connection profiles, and shell completions.
